The young girl (R2) is positioned higher on the right, resting against the woman's chest while looking up and forward with a joyful expression. The woman's hands are clasped tightly around the girl's legs. The scene is illuminated by bright, direct daylight, creating vibrant colors with the saturated pink dress and green shirt contrasting against the deep blue sky.
